prompt.alinti: This hidden GitHub repo gives you the superpower to orchestrate advanced AI workflows completely offline.
Orca is a lightweight framework designed to help you build and deploy custom AI agents locally on your machine, protecting your data while saving you from expensive API costs.
Comment Orca below and I'll send you the repository.
Run Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side each in its own worktree, tracked in one place.
Monitor and steer your agents from anywhere.
notified when an agent finishes and send follow-ups from anywhere.
Fan one prompt across five agents, each in its own isolated git worktree, compare the results and merge the winner.
Click any UI element in a real Chromium window to send its HTML, CSS, and a cropped screenshot straight into your agent's prompt.
Browse PRs, issues, and project boards in-app, open a worktree from any task and review without a context switch.
Run agents on a beefy remote box with SSH Worktrees, full file editing, git, and terminals - auto-reconnect and port forwarding.
